shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,280p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && git branch --show-current && sed -n '1,180p' src/transport/ws/validation.ts && sed -n '1,150p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts && sed -n '1,130p' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,210p' src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts && sed -n '1,100p' src/types/messages.test.ts && rg -n \"list_sessions|session_list|Conversation|conversation\" specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md .lore/test-commands.yml package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '1,220p'
nl -ba src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts | sed -n '35,195p'
nl -ba src/types/messages.test.ts | sed -n '1,70p'
sed -n '65,90p' specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
sed -n '120,260p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
rg -n \"reanchor|prettier|format\" package.json scripts/spec-links -g '*' 2>/dev/null"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,100p' src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts && rg -n \"list_sessions|session_list\" specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md && git diff --check && git diff --stat"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '100,220p' src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts
rg -n \"list_sessions|session_list\" specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md || true
git diff -- src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npx prettier --write src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md .lore/dod.md && node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"it\\('(exposes list_sessions|asks the session store|logs a rejected|answers list_sessions|answers an empty|accepts a bare)\" src/types/messages.test.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts
rg -n \"exposes list_sessions|asks the session store|logs a rejected|answers list_sessions|answers an empty|accepts a bare\" specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md && timeout 300 npx jest --runTestsByPath src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts --runInBand'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git status --short && git diff -- .lore/dod.md src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npx prettier --write src/transport/ws/validation.ts specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md && tail -n 8 src/transport/ws/validation.ts && git diff --check && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts && git commit -m "Document WebSocket conversation listing" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git status --short --branch'
